answers.how: The phoenix spans about 209 pixels from beak to tail. Its measured acceleration is about 94 pixels/s², giving 209 × 2/94 meters.
The trajectory is approximately uniformly accelerated from rest. Using the measured pixel-motion scale, its speed at 0.5 seconds is approximately 1 m/s.
The trajectory is approximately uniformly accelerated from rest. Using the measured pixel-motion scale, its speed at 1.0 seconds is approximately 2 m/s.
